inputs.text: I heard they're ramming through a new gun control bill in New York as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, with the usual claim that it will force guns sold there to be built so they can't be easily modified into illegal machine guns, plus criminal penalties for whatever they decide counts. That's just the cover story, though. This is another coordinated move by the hidden elites to disarm regular people step by step, using the modification excuse as pure manipulation to expand their control, criminalize more ownership, and leave only the powerful armed while boxing the rest of us in. It's all about locking down the narrative and blocking any real pushback against their agenda—don't fall for it.
